title: Business health (gate scorecard)
description: ADR success metrics vs Phase-1 gate. Source: metric_daily.

panels.title: Phase-1 gate scorecard
panels.description: ADR-v0.1 Phase-1 gate. Latest computed day per gate metric vs target. The admin scorecard uses only matured days; here the latest day may still be maturing (see denominator).

targets.rawSql:
WITH t(metric,op,target) AS (VALUES ('lead_to_conversation_rate','ge',0.6),('conversation_to_deal_rate','ge',0.15),('auto_refund_rate','lt',0.1),('t1_plus_seller_share','ge',0.8),('false_badge_proxy','lt',0.005),('time_to_first_listing_median_minutes','lt',15),('onboarding_completion_rate','ge',0.6)),
latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric) metric, day, value, denominator FROM metric_daily WHERE dimension='' AND metric IN (SELECT metric FROM t) ORDER BY metric, day DESC)
SELECT t.metric, l.day, l.value, t.target, l.denominator AS sample,
  CASE WHEN l.value IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN (t.op='ge' AND l.value>=t.target) OR (t.op='lt' AND l.value<t.target) THEN 'meets' ELSE 'misses' END AS status
FROM t LEFT JOIN latest l USING (metric) ORDER BY t.metric

panels.title: Lead to conversation
panels.description: metric_daily.lead_to_conversation_rate; cohort-anchored, recent days keep changing until the window matures (docs/design/metrics.md).

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, value AS "lead_to_conversation_rate" FROM metric_daily WHERE metric='lead_to_conversation_rate' AND dimension='' AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day
